title: Ilhan Omar says 'bizarre' pre-dawn raid on her home is forcing her to move out
caption:
Minnesota Representative Ilhan Omar says she is moving after federal agents conducted an hours-long search of her home. Agents seized seventeen items, including notebooks and phones, as part of an ongoing criminal investigation.

Source: Bbc - Ilhan Omar says 'bizarre' pre-dawn raid on her home is forcing her to move out
